hints.title: Target Value Selection
hints.text: To minimize modifications, choose the value that already occurs most frequently in the array.

hints.title: Frequency Map Counting
hints.text: Count the occurrences of every number in a single linear pass.

hints.title: Complementary Subtraction
hints.text: Subtract the maximum frequency from the total length of the array.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def minOperations(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        # Minimum operations to equalize elements
        # Equal to total elements minus the frequency of the most frequent element
        if not nums:
            return 0
        freq = Counter(nums)
        max_f = max(freq.values())
        return len(nums) - max_f
```

complexity.notes: Single pass frequency tally via hash map.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested loops to count frequencies run in quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Frequency map requires O(U) space bounded by distinct values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that operations needed equal total elements minus mode frequency.
